name: Anime USA
blurb: A Washington D.C.-area anime convention with video and tabletop gaming, a masquerade, idol showcase and artist alley.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'ANIME USA XXVI: THE RPG November 20-22, 2026 Westfields Marriott Washington Dulles'

notes: Moved to the Westfields Marriott Washington Dulles (in Chantilly, VA) starting this edition, per the seed note and the homepage. Each 2026 Guests card only shows a name plus a one-or-two-word role label (e.g. 'Voice Actor', 'Artist') with no specific show credit, so Known-for is left blank throughout, matching how role-only cards were handled elsewhere. Skipped one candidate ('Otaku Brain Trust', explicitly labeled a 'Panelist Group') under the skip-panels rule, plus the page's own logo, a 'Anime USA Guests' section banner, and a footer social-link banner. No og/twitter image on this site (the theme's template/demo images were excluded as not real event art), so the cover uses the Anime USA logo.
